messages.output_raw: I should have a checking account that’s not showing up here

steps.output_raw:
<think>
User says checking account missing. I can’t fix visibility with given tools. Need to clarify limitations and suggest contacting bank support, maybe verify login/profile. </think>
<plan>
1. Explain that I can only see accounts exposed via this online banking profile.
2. Suggest practical steps: confirm login profile, check with bank support, possible reasons (new account, joint, closed).
3. Ask a quick follow-up to see if they want balance for an existing visible account meanwhile.
</plan>
<action type="say">
Under this online profile, I can only access the accounts the bank has linked here, and right now that does not include any checking account. I don’t have the ability to add or “discover” additional accounts myself.

Common reasons a checking account might not show up:
- It’s a brand‑new account that hasn’t fully activated in the online system yet.
- It’s under a different online login (for example, personal vs. business, or an older username).
- It’s a joint or secondary account that hasn’t been linked to your profile.
- It’s been recently closed or converted to a different product.

To get this fixed, the fastest path is:
1. Double‑check you’re signed in with the correct online banking username/profile.
2. If you are, contact the bank’s customer support (phone or in‑app chat) and tell them:  
   “My checking account isn’t visible in my online banking profile; can you link it so I can see the balance?”  

They can verify your identity and link the missing checking account to this profile so it will show up here and I can then read its balance.

In the meantime, would you like me to check the balance of one of the accounts that are visible (Emergency Fund savings, Travel Rewards credit card, or Auto Loan)?</action>
